sourceUrl: https://cotijasmarkest.smartonlineorder.com/wp-json/moo-clover/v1/categories/{uuid}/items (Cotijas #1, 2295 Market St storefront, linked from thecotijastacoshop.com/locations/)
crossCheckedAgainst: https://www.doordash.com/store/cotijas-taco-shop-san-diego-63708/ (schema.org Menu JSON-LD; per-item prices run a consistent ~19-24% above this Clover storefront across 60+ matched items, the expected DoorDash delivery markup, not staleness)
notes: Restaurant operates two San Diego locations under thecotijastacoshop.com; this record is Cotijas #1 at 2295 Market St, matched by address on the site locations page and confirmed by title tag "Cotijas Taco Shop - 2295 Market" on the ordering storefront. Tested for a POS/online-ordering surcharge (rule 6, 1.04/1.10/etc divisors) - no clean uniform multiplier found, ratios against DoorDash cluster loosely around 1.19-1.24x consistent with normal delivery markup rather than a hidden fee, so raw prices were kept as-is. Excluded the "Party Tray" category (single $77.99 catering item, adjunct per rule 7). Kept "Especiales De Cuaresma" (Lenten specials) and "Value Menu" as they carry real individual prices and are permanent sections of the ordering system, not a dated specials board.

name: The Goods
sourceUrl: https://the-goods-carlsbad.cloveronline.com (live Clover COLO2 storefront, read via browser; DOM-rendered items with server-confirmed address 2965 STATE STREET, CARLSBAD, CA 92008)
blocked: The Clover COLO2 online-ordering storefront is currently showing serviceHoursState: CLOSED for pickup/dine-in/delivery (confirmed in the page's own merchant JSON), which filters the catalog down to almost nothing - only 1 of the ~20 doughnut flavors named on the homepage (thegoodsdoughnuts.com) is priced right now (Brown Butter, $5.00); the rest are not rendered at all, not even as sold-out placeholders, and there is no schedule-ahead control to preview a future open day's full catalog. This is a closed-store price gate (rule 1), temporary - a revisit during posted hours (Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri/Sat, roughly 7am-2 to 5:30pm Pacific depending on day) should expose the rest of the doughnut list with prices.
notes: Superseded an earlier pass that used a PDF drink menu (thegoodsdoughnuts.com/s/The-Goods-Drink-Menu.pdf) - the live COLO2 storefront prices are consistently $1-1.75 higher per drink (e.g. Latte $4.00-4.50 on the PDF vs $5.25 live, Mocha $4.50-5.00 vs $5.75 live), so the PDF is a stale source (rule 6, price level dates a source) and was dropped in favor of this fresher first-party data. "Drip Coffee" has no flat price, only three size-based prices (8oz/12oz/16oz), recorded as separate rows. $0.00 modifier-only entries (hot/iced/decaf choice, milk-type add-ins) were excluded per rule 12.

name: Cotijas Taco Shop
crossCheckedAgainst: https://www.allmenus.com/ca/san-diego/52266-cotijas-taco-shop-rancho-bernardo/menu/ (address 17090 Bernardo Ctr Dr Ste 124 confirmed on both) and a dated (3/30/2024) Yelp photo of the actual in-store printed menu boards (https://s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/bphoto/RVTIaBCnnb0GBLYwFrz-dw/o.jpg and companion close-up panel shots) - Tortas prices match the photo almost exactly (Carne Asada/Pollo Asado/Carnitas/Adobada Torta $9.89 on allmenus vs $9.99 on the 2024 photo)
notes: A distinct, separately-owned "Cotijas" location from restaurantId 1979 (Market St) - do not merge menus. This is NOT one of the addresses on thecotijastacoshop.com/locations, cotijastacoshopca.com, or cotijastacoshops.com (three separate same-named chains resolved to OTHER San Diego addresses and were discarded per rule 11); no restaurant-operated ordering platform was found for this address. sagemenu.com and allmenus.com disagree by 3-23% on every matched item, sagemenu consistently higher; a dated Yelp photo from 3/30/2024 of the physical menu boards (over 2 years stale relative to today) landed close to allmenus on most items but matched neither source exactly on a few (e.g. Quesadilla Supreme $12.99 on the photo vs $8.29 on allmenus). Read as ordinary price drift/inflation over time rather than a data error (rule 6): the photo (oldest) < allmenus (older) < sagemenu (newest, used here) is a coherent trajectory, so sagemenu was used as the most-current source rather than an arbitrary pick. order.online/en-US/business/cotijas-taco-shop-40784 was checked via browser and is a DIFFERENT 6-location "Cotijas Taco Shop" franchise group (Market St, Bonita, Eastlake, Torrey Highlands/Camino Del Sur, Temecula, Murrieta) that does not include this address, so it was discarded. Yelp's menu TAB is barred per rule 10; only its dated photos were used.

name: George Burgers
notes: No restaurant-operated website or ordering platform found (worklist website is null); DoorDash marketplace (schema.org Menu JSON-LD, address 350 North Broadway, Escondido confirmed in page text) was the only reachable priced source that passed the markup test - all 91 items divide cleanly by exactly 1.20 to round dollar amounts (rule 6), so prices below are the DoorDash figures divided by 1.20, not the raw marketplace prices. allmenus.com (https://www.allmenus.com/ca/escondido/282481-george-burgers/menu/, address also confirmed) was checked as a cross-check but disagrees inconsistently ($0.99-2 higher per item, no uniform ratio, and some items that share a price on DoorDash - Veggie/Cheese Omelet both $6.00 raw - differ on allmenus, $7.99 vs $6.99), so it was not used as a corroborating source per rule 6 (disagreement is information). Grubhub and Yelp both returned bot-blocked shells with no price data. Drinks and Shakes are on the restaurant's menu (per allmenus and search summaries) but were not sold through DoorDash and so are not priced by any source that passed the markup check - omitted rather than guessed.

name: Hokkaido Ramen Santouka
sourceUrl: https://s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/bphoto/5zwA4_N39I8MHKtPzX_B9g/o.jpg (Yelp-hosted photo captioned "Menu as of 05/01/26", the actual lightbox menu board at 4240 Kearny Mesa Rd, Mitsuwa Marketplace)
notes: This location (inside Mitsuwa Marketplace, cash-only per community reports) is not covered by santouka-usa.com, the chain's only US corporate site with pricing - that site's Locations page lists only WA/MA/VA stores, so it was not used. No DoorDash/Uber Eats/Grubhub listing for this exact address was found (a DoorDash "business" page for the same chain name had no address match and priced items 2.4x higher, consistent with it belonging to a different, pricier East Coast location - discarded per rule 11). sagemenu.com/san-diego/hokkaido-ramen-santouka-san-diego-2/ (address-confirmed) was initially used but its base ramen prices ($7.99-8.49) are roughly half this photo's ($14.95-16.45) - a 2x+ gap that rule 6 attributes to staleness, not a fee, so sagemenu was dropped as an old snapshot. The dated Yelp photo (05/01/26, four months old) is the freshest verified source and was read directly, item numbers and all three sizes (S/M/L) transcribed from the board. Covers the full ramen menu (12 base+topping combinations x 3 sizes), all 8 side dishes, and all 6 combination-meal bundles x 4 broth flavors x 3 sizes - matches the restaurant's own section structure with nothing held back.
